title: St. Leo the Great, Pope and Doctor
subtitle: Memorial · Ti 2:1-8, 11-14; Lk 17:7-10
text: In 452, Pope Leo rode out unarmed to meet Attila the Hun, and Rome was spared. He also gave the Church the clear teaching on Christ as true God and true man that Chalcedon received with the words: Peter has spoken through Leo. Christian, recognize your dignity.
imageAlt: Painted oval portrait of Pope St. Leo the Great in papal vestments and tiara, gazing upward
